title: Hunt 5AM Gravel Limitless: Durable Aero Anyone?
content:
The new Hunt 5AM Gravel Limitless wheelset brings a radical approach to aerodynamic efficiency. Even if aero isn’t your everything, these hoops have some tricks up their sleeve for pinch flat protection. And they look cool. Read below for all the tech-heavy details.

Gravel racing has gotten incredibly fast, and aerodynamics are vital for athletes vying for the podium. Hunt spent years developing this wheelset and made some interesting decisions that set it apart from its competitors. Namely, the front wheel is deeper and wider than the rear. Additionally, the bead walls are wider than just about any other wheel out there to protect against pinch flats. The greatest aerodynamic designs are rendered useless when you’re sitting on the side of the road patching a sidewall. Depending on your budget or preference, these new wheels can be purchased in two flavors: carbon spokes or steel spokes. Let’s get into the nitty-gritty details.

Hunt 5AM Gravel Limitless Quick Hits

  • Weight: 1317 g per pair (carbon spokes) or 1447 g per pair (steel spokes)
  • Front Rim: 54 mm deep. 45 mm wide rim profile with patented Limitless Width AeroTech. 27 mm internal rim width. 9mm-wide rim bead. Hookless tyre interface.
  • Rear Rim: 49 mm deep. 38 mm wide rim profile. 27 mm internal rim width. 5.5 mm-wide rim bead. Hookless tire interface.
  • Carbon Spokes: 20 front / 20 rear VONOA Ti_UD Carbon Spokes, 2-cross, non-interlacing, 1.7 g per spoke, with internal spoke nipples
  • Steel Spokes: 24 front / 24 rear Pillar Super Wing 20 straight-pull, triple butted (2.2/0.95/2.0 mm) aero bladed stainless steel spokes, 2-cross, with double square internal spoke nipples
  • Hub System: HUNT H_Ratchet 48T DBL. 7.5° engagement angle. Precision-machined 6061-T6 alloy with 7075 alloy axles. Dual-sided, nickel-coated ratchet system.
  • Available with CeramicSpeed Alpha or precision stainless steel bearings. 310 g per pair.
  • Tires: Aero-optimized for 45 mm and 50 mm tires; compatible with 40-60 mm hookless (TSS) tires.
  • Carbon Spoke Pricing:
    • £2,449 | €2,899 | $2,899 w/stainless steel bearings
    • £2,799 | €3,299 | $3,299 w/CeramicSpeed Alpha bearings
  • Steel Spoke Pricing: £1,999 | €2,399 | $2,399
  • Lifetime free crash replacement for original owners.

Hunt 5AM Gravel Limitless Design Overview

The 5AM Gravel Limitless was engineered to prioritize key performance benefits: aerodynamic drag reduction optimized for modern gravel racing tires (45-50mm); pinch flat protection and race-ready durability; stability and predictability in changing wind conditions; and low system weight for responsiveness and climbing efficiency. These demands are achieved through front- and rear-specific Aero Maximized wheel designs, which consider each component in the context of optimal system efficiency.

The front wheel runs in clean air, offering the greatest opportunity to reduce aerodynamic drag. By increasing rim depth and width, while minimizing rotational drag with hidden spoke nipples, the 5AM Gravel maximizes aerodynamic efficiency where it matters most without compromising crosswind stability. The 45mm-wide external rim profile with 9mm-wide rim beads smooths the airflow from wide gravel tires across the rim profile. The wide, blunt profile of the bead is designed to spread impact force, preventing pinch flats. Patented Limitless Width Aero Technology enables a rim with wide, blunt dimensions and classleading aerodynamic and side wind handling characteristics, while maintaining a low rim weight. It does so by utilizing low-density structural polymer (0.7g/cm3) molded into the rim sidewall between carbon layers (1.6g/cm3).

What does that mean on gravel? The wheel carries speed like a deeper wheel, with the light weight and stable feel of a shallower wheel. The rear wheel encounters turbulent airflow, downstream of the front wheel, tire, frame, and rider movement, making rear wheel aerodynamic gains less important in the context of the complete system. Rear wheel efficiency is achieved by reducing weight and maximizing power transfer. A shallower, narrower rim with a 5.5mm-wide bead provides efficient transmission of power to the ground and prevents pinch flats.
